name: Avatar
looksLike: small round photo beside a persons name
circle with initials when there is no photo
little face picture next to a comment
definition: A small image or initials representing a person or account, often shown beside a name.

notConfusedWith.difference: Shows a short status or count rather than a person or account.

prompts.short: Add an avatar with initials as a fallback and an accessible identity label.
prompts.detailed: Add a circular avatar beside a visible user name. Use an empty image alt when the adjacent name already identifies the person. Fall back to initials if the photo is missing or fails. If the avatar is the only content of an action, give that button or link an accessible name.

reactTailwind: export function Avatar({ src, name, initials }: {
setFailedSrc(src)} className="size-11 rounded-full object-cover" />
{initials}
vue: defineProps({ name: { type: String, default: "Alex Morgan" }, initials: { type: String, default: "AM" } });
a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }
.avatar { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 50%; font-weight: bold; }

a11yNotes: Avoid redundant image alt when a visible name is adjacent
Provide an accessible name for an avatar-only action
Do not use the photo alone to communicate status
